queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Topics to search, one search per line (up to 200 characters each, up to 20 queries). Every paper found becomes one result. Leave empty to search nothing and use only the DOIs.

dois.title: DOIs to look up
dois.description: DOIs of papers to fetch, one per line, e.g. 10.1038/nature14539 or https://doi.org/10.1038/nature14539 (up to 50). Each DOI found becomes one result and includes the abstract where OpenAlex holds it.

year_from.title: Earliest publication year
year_from.description: Optional. Only papers published in this year or later are returned by the searches. It does not apply to DOI lookups.

max_results_per_query.title: Papers per search
max_results_per_query.description: How many papers each search returns, 1 to 25. Every paper returned is one charged result.
